candidates.title: fix(sdk): walk full index history in claim yield calculation
candidates.body:
## Overview

The wM yield bot resumed after its July data outage and every claim batch failed on-chain with error `6005`, `InsufficientCollateral`. The claim calculation capped its index-update window at the on-chain global timestamp, which only advances on sync and had been frozen since 13 Jul, so the whole 73-day gap collapsed into one `pendingSync` step priced at the earner's current balance. One earner's balance grew 50x in the final week, which inflated its claim to `32,489 wM` against a true time-weighted yield of `3,737 wM` per the [yield derivation](https://gist.github.com/Oighty/d239d
